content: The Hell event in GTA 6 proves that you never know where a wild night in Leonidas can take you. On a quiet street, you might come across Dave and Beelzebub hanging out in a garage and listening to some rock. After a quick chat, you will learn that both of them are followers of Satan and enthusiasts of non-human vocalists in metal bands. If you stay around long enough, the two guys will invite you to take part in a special ritual, giving you the chance to start a unique event in the game.
